array.string: key="$HOME/.ssh/macos-signing/id_ecdsa_sk_rk" if [ ! -r "$key" ]; then exit 0 fi if [ -z "$SSH_AUTH_SOCK" ]; then SSH_AUTH_SOCK=$(/bin/launchctl getenv SSH_AUTH_SOCK) export SSH_AUTH_SOCK fi fingerprint=$(/usr/bin/ssh-keygen -lf "$key.pub" -E sha256 | /usr/bin/awk '{print $2}') || exit 1 if /usr/bin/ssh-add -l -E sha256 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/grep -Fq "$fingerprint"; then exit 0 fi exec /usr/bin/ssh-add -S /usr/lib/ssh-keychain.dylib "$key"
